construction: Unchanged independent-mask input rule, columns, intervals, ridge and four-bit candidate from v91; 17 uniformly sampled distinct rows, response-independent row choice.
fallback: When the energy certificate misses the target, construct an exact degree-four reference-residual polynomial; validate rounded nonnegative and PSD duals; refine the highest-upper original completion box.

reference.scope: Each evaluated node uses its own domain; clipped feasible witness and node midpoint initialize the exchange.

branching: Largest upper node, midpoint of cell maximizing moment variance times sum of absolute polynomial coefficients containing that cell; at most 31 evaluated nodes; keep parent upper until both covering children finish.
clock: Charge data/input, candidate, anchor, coarse witness, basis, energy, numerical reference, multistart, polynomial and dual validation. Python imports and writing receipts are outside benchmark convention; this implementation conservatively includes receipt writes inside refinement time. Credit only evidence actually completed at each deadline.
failure_policy: Retain every condition and error; continue queue. Future changes require a new protocol and separate validation records.
